propositions: Container tickets with no declared file_impact fall back to whole-HEAD invalidation, causing attestations to be invalidated by any unrelated commit.
Container plan-review scope should inherit the union of direct children's file_impact declarations, but only when all non-closed children declare non-empty file_impact (poison rule).
Closed children should neither contribute their file_impact to the inherited union nor trigger the poison rule, since their work is already delivered.

When a non-closed direct child edits its file_impact or is added/removed after a container attestation, the container's attestation must be invalidated via material fingerprint drift to force re-review.
The P9 determinism floor should emit an advisory (non-blocking) naming non-closed children with empty file_impact when container inheritance is poisoned.
